(()=>{const out={}; window.__scene.traverse(o=>{ if(!o.isMesh) return; let v=true; o.traverseAncestors(a=>{if(!a.visible) v=false}); if(!o.visible||!v) return; const g=o.geometry; const t=(g.index?g.index.count:g.attributes.position.count)/3; let top=o; while(top.parent && top.parent.parent && top.parent.name!=='building' && top.parent.name!=='city' && top.parent.name!=='roof' && top.parent.type!=='Scene') top=top.parent; const k=(top.name||top.type)+'/'+(Array.isArray(o.material)?'multi':o.material.name||o.material.type); out[k]=(out[k]||0)+t; }); return JSON.stringify(Object.entries(out).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).slice(0,18).map(([k,v])=>k+': '+Math.round(v/1000)+'k'))})()
